subject: Pack-and-port proposal: Medimetrix pilot packaging & migration
messages:
From: Cassidy Jones <cassidy@medimetrics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@medimetrics.com
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pack-and-port options for pilot

Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking a look — attached is a brief usage export and a short summary of our requirements. We are evaluating Redwood for a 12-week pilot with potential to scale to production. Topline:
- ~120k tokens/day today (in spikes)
- Low single-digit latency requirement for user-facing features
- Must support private deployment or dedicated capacity (data residency + audit logs)

Questions:
1) Which packaging best matches a 12-week pilot that may transition to dedicated? Compact (metered) vs Reserved Dedicated?
2) Can we bundle the private VPC deployment feature and audit logs as a single SKU? Any uplift?
3) Discounting: what's the entry-level concession for a pilot converting within 90 days?

Attachment: medimetrics-current-usage.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — can we schedule a quick call tomorrow to go over options?

Best,
Cassidy Jones
VP Product, Medimetrix
cassidy@medimetrics.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Cassidy Jones <cassidy@medimetrics.com>
Cc: procurement@medimetrics.com
Date: 2026-05-17T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pack-and-port options for pilot

Hi Cassidy — thanks for the note and the export. A few quick thoughts that should help surface the right packaging.

Short answer: we can support a 12-week pilot that cleanly converts to dedicated capacity, but the right SKU depends on two tradeoffs: cost predictability vs lowest upfront spend.

Options (top-level):
- Metered / Compact (hosted): low upfront, pay-as-you-go. Good if you want minimal commitment but expect higher per-token unit cost once you scale.
- Reserved Dedicated (Pilot Lite): reserved pool for the pilot period — better unit economics, predictable throughput, supports private VPC and audit logs. One-time setup for VPC + audit config.

Suggested approach for Medimetrix (given residency + low-latency):
1) Run a 12-week Pilot Lite (reserved) with a small dedicated pool sized for current spikes + 20% buffer.
2) Include Private VPC + Audit Logs as a bundled add-on (one setup charge + monthly entitlement).
3) Offer a conversion path: if you convert to a 12-month reserved commitment within 90 days of pilot start, we can apply a conversion credit and a first-year discount.

I've attached a draft price sketch and a simple migration flow — Alex and Rishi, please see below for pricing guidance and confirm margins/discount flexibility.

Attachment: redwood-pack-pricing-v1.pdf (pdf)

If that approach sounds reasonable, I can set up a parallel call with Alex (pricing) and Rishi (security/compliance) tomorrow. What time works for you?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pack-and-port options for pilot (pricing rec)

Laura — internal recommendation below (cc: Rishi for the compliance side).

Recap of ask: 12-week pilot, private deployment option, audit logs, path to convert to annual reserved.

Pricing / packaging recommendation (Pilot Lite):
- Pilot reserved pool (N GPU hours / predicted tokens): $9,500/month (pilot-sized pool)
- One-time private VPC & audit setup: $4,000 (covers networking + KMS integration + log routing)
- Audit logs entitlement: $500/month
- Conversion path: if they commit to 12 months within the pilot window, apply a 15% first-year discount and credit the one-time setup toward first invoice (net-zero if they convert).
- Pilot credits: offer $5k in platform credits for term-conversion incentive (reduces pilot run-cost).

Notes:
- Margin: with the 15% discount + $5k credit we remain above internal margin floor for a deal of this scale.
- If procurement pushes for lower net-first-year cost we can trade on a longer annual commitment or a monthly ramp schedule.

Attachment: redwood-pack-pricing-v1.pdf (pdf)

Rishi — any compliance flags for offering the one-time VPC setup credit? Is there extra legal language we should require in SOW?

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwoodinference.com

We'd like to proceed with the Pilot Lite reserved option with the Private VPC + audit logs bundled. The conversion incentives look fair — the 15% conversion discount + $5k pilot credit are acceptable starting points for internal approval.

Next steps from our side:

- Availability for a 30-minute call on Friday (May 21) morning PST to align on SOW language and scope.

I'll loop in our legal if needed but procurement asked me to confirm we want the bundled Pilot Lite. Please send the formal quote and a proposed SOW draft.
